rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: AROplumi
rows.Origin: Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, before 1988).
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. Strong, fruity fragrance. 20 to 25 petals. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 10b. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
